notes.title: 🐟 Desktank is now Free to Play! 🐠
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone! Just wanted to share that my cozy little desktop aquarium game, [b]Desktank[/b], is now [b]free to play[/b] on Steam![/p][p]It’s a relaxing experience where fish swim around your screen while you work or study — something simple and peaceful to keep you company.[/p][p]If that sounds like something you’d enjoy, I’d love for you to check it out and let me know what you think! 😊[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2722730/Desktank/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Quality and Balancing update v3.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36096281/bf35ac9aeba628be37d8d73527bfe8a3fbdf3199.png[/img]

The difficulty of the game was balanced and it feels like a different game now, we tested it for a few weeks and we are happy with the results. The timer moves faster now and the AI of the enemy was also improved, we tried to make it as fair and clear as possible so that nothing feels random.

In the latest update, many aspects of the game were reworked or replaced, the tutorial was completely rebuilt to make it more clear for new players, the HUD was also improved, the icons, sounds, and the graphics were slightly improved.

All known bugs were fixed and the game was optimized for the best performance possible.

We’ll love to hear your feedback, please let us know how we can improve the game further.

notes.title: Update v2.0.0 - Difficulty balanced + Steam achievements + Bug free!
notes.notes:
I've been updating the game almost every day for the last week, trying to improve it as much as possible, but with this new update, I think that the difficulty is finally perfectly balanced, Steam achievements were also introduced into the game and all known bugs have been fixed.

Please share your feedback, I'm always looking for ways to improve the game.

Currently working on Steam Trading Cards.

Stay tuned for a new update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36096281/0645e2eafe0b48ea44ab55e042421e629658eb8e.png[/img]
